EQ:1538621.narrative: A deep magnitude 4.9 quake under the Tonga Islands, where the Pacific Plate dives beneath the Australian Plate at one of the steepest subduction angles on Earth.

EQ:1538615.narrative: A magnitude 5 quake struck the South Sandwich Islands region, an uninhabited sub-Antarctic arc with no permanent population in the wider affected area.

EQ:1538614.narrative: A shallow-felt tremor in eastern Indonesia, where 284M people live across an archipelago straddling the Pacific Ring of Fire. Only about 1,213 people sit in the wider affected area, sparing the dense urban centers further west.
